chosen_method.name: CSCV/PBO stability audit
chosen_method.reason: The current blocker is positive average PnL with unstable root/market breadth. PBO directly checks whether variants selected in-sample keep above-median rank out of sample across root splits.

sources_considered.name: Deflated Sharpe Ratio
sources_considered.reason: Useful for multiple-testing inflation, but less direct for root/market breadth than split-rank PBO.

sources_considered.name: Group DRO
sources_considered.reason: Existing group-DRO rescue still has zero support rows on the current sample.

sources_considered.name: Conformal Risk Control
sources_considered.reason: Existing conformal abstention rescue did not produce a prequential gate pass.
